question_1_l1_reproduce_source_grid.question: Can Sentinel-1 Level-1 coordinates reproduce the source geolocation grid?
question_1_l1_reproduce_source_grid.explanation: Level-1 XML geolocation grid points reproduce their own tiepoints under piecewise bivariate bilinear interpolation with 0.00 m residual.

question_2_li_corner_metadata_consistenc.question: Can the Li GeoTIFF corner metadata be interpreted consistently?
question_2_li_corner_metadata_consistenc.explanation: Inverted corner coordinates span 2,550.0 native index units, which is mathematically consistent with 10x block aggregation of a 2,560-cell window under the Center Convention, provided perimeter ordering is re-indexed.

question_3_independent_crop_transformati.question: Has the exact Li pixel-to-Level-1 crop transformation been independently established?
question_3_independent_crop_transformati.explanation: No independent source generation code, published crop offsets, or physical SAR intensity cross-correlation exist in project evidence. The correspondence is inferred from the same corner GCPs.

arithmetic_reconciliation.verdict: Mathematically consistent with 10x block downsampling, but unverified from source dataset generation code.

residual_15_79m_audit.independence_classification: RESIDUAL IS CONDITIONAL ON ASSUMED CORRESPONDENCE
residual_15_79m_audit.independent_evidence_search_result: NO INDEPENDENT LI-PIXEL-TO-L1 CORRESPONDENCE EVIDENCE FOUND

orientation_audit.note: Verified for 9 GeoTIFF slices across 2 controls; uncertain across 10 controls due to absence of GeoTIFF metadata.

gcp_ordering_audit.details: Perimeter polygon vertex ordering (TL -> BL -> BR -> TR) in Tag 33922 causes diagonal shear if ingested into a Cartesian grid without re-indexing. Not established as a dataset corruption bug.

models_assessment.model_d_2d_affine: Not suitable as the general physical geolocation model for this SAR geometry under the tested spatial extent; may remain a local approximation.

conceptual_distinctions.half_pixel_displacement: 50.0m is the distance from pixel center to pixel edge in a 100m raster.
conceptual_distinctions.registration_uncertainty: Physical registration uncertainty remains unquantified (no intensity matching).

incidents.title: 2550 vs 2560 Native Line/Pixel Arithmetic Normalization Mismatch
Conflation of Total Control Slices (47) with Evaluated GeoTIFF Slices (9 across 2 Controls)
incidents.description: Phase 7C and 7C-R1 reported that 47 Li slices across 12 control products were evaluated in the alignment model comparison with max residual 15.8m. Forensic audit revealed that while 47 slice label masks are linked to the 12 scenes, only 9 GeoTIFF slices (Controls 1 and 2) were present in scratch/li_sample/Image_Geo/ and evaluated in slice_level_evaluations. Controls 3-12 were not evaluated for geometric residual or orientation.
incidents.root_cause: Conflation of metadata label inventory with local GeoTIFF sample evaluation scope.
incidents.correction: Distinguish declared slice label count (47 across 12 controls) from evaluated GeoTIFF slice count (9 across 2 controls). Label orientation as ORIENTATION_UNCERTAIN for Controls 3-12.
incidents.lesson_learned: Sample evaluation scope must never be conflated with metadata inventory scope.
